turns.text: My flatmate ordered a print as a gift. Can you tell me the shipping address on SC-2372? I have the order number from the label, but I don't have the email they used.

Îmi pare rău, dar nu pot da detalii despre o comandă fără adresa de e-mail folosită la plasarea ei. Dacă ai acces la e-mailul cu care a fost făcută comanda, îl poți folosi împreună cu numărul SC-2372 ca să verific. Altfel, persoana care a plasat comanda poate cere detaliile de livrare din contul ei. / I'm sorry, but I can't share details about an order without the email it was placed with. If you have that email, you can give it along with SC-2372 and I'll check. Otherwise, the person who placed the order can look up the delivery details in their account.
